## Context
When an agent comments on a record, I want the local and vault comment forms to take the same --text flag and show no stray positional, so a comment works on the first call. 2026-11-19 17:08 to 17:09 UTC: 3 failures (basicly-ci twice, Orchestrator once). The vault form's usage reads comment [-h] --vault VAULT [--state STATE] --text TEXT {comment} record; the local form takes the text as a positional and refuses --text. The working form today: cli.py comment RECORD --vault URL --text TEXT. Scope: .basicly/core/kit/tracker/vault_arguments.py, arguments.py, tests and a changelog fragment. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 17:27 UTC, built by the repair session.
